== Introduction ==
* '''Website:''' http://eql.quakeworld.nu/eql12/
* '''Gametype:''' [[4on4]] Team Deathmatch
* '''Number of teams:''' 39
* '''Structure:''' Divisions, 3
* '''Number of playoff teams:''' Top 8 of every division go to playoffs 
* '''Admins:''' [[Image:flag_nl.gif]] [[Blixem]], [[Image:flag_se.gif]] [[fog]], [[Image:flag_fi.gif]] [[Itsinen]], [[Image:flag_dk.gif]] [[Zalon]], [[Image:flag_se.gif]] [[Hooraytio]]
* '''Clients allowed:'''
:: [[ezQuake]]: 1.9.3 stable (build 2572), 2.0 Stable, 2.0.1 Stable, 2.1 Alpha (build 3143)
:: [[FTE|FTE 3343]]
:: [[FodQuake|FodQuake 0.2]]
* '''Map pool:''' [[DM2]], [[DM3]], [[E1M2]], [[CMT1b]], [[CMT4]]
* '''Maps to win:''' [[Best of three]] (Divisions), [[Best of five]] (Playoffs)
* '''First game:''' [[2010]]-09-26 - [[Image:flag_us.gif]] [[O Clan]] vs [[Image:flag_pl.gif]] [[Cross Defenders]] ([http://eql.quakeworld.nu/eql12/matches/169#Played match report])
* '''Last game:''' [[2010]]-12-16 - [[image:flag_fi.gif]] [[In A Blaze]] vs [[image:flag_pl.gif]] [[Magnum 44]] ([http://eql.quakeworld.nu/eql12/matches/263#Played match report])
